suspects.name: Silas
suspects.personality: Bitter, desperate, cunning, prone to outbursts.
suspects.physicalDescription: Gaunt and weary, with dark, sunken eyes and unkempt, greying hair. He wears patched, once-fine alchemist robes, stained with various chemicals.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was at Alistair's laboratory, confronting him and causing the explosion.
suspects.claimedAlibi: I was at the 'Gilded Goblet' tavern, drowning my sorrows, all evening. Ask anyone there.
suspects.trueMotive: To steal Alistair's discovery of the Sunpetal Bloom and reclaim his former glory.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: He is the one who caused the explosion that killed Alistair.
suspects.lyingTells: Becomes agitated and defensive when asked about his whereabouts around the time of death.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: He knows Willow was Alistair's apprentice and likely knew about his research. He might also know of other alchemists who envied Alistair.

suspects.name: Willow
suspects.personality: Diligent, observant, a bit naive, fiercely loyal to Alistair.
suspects.physicalDescription: Young and earnest, with bright, curious eyes and practical, tied-back auburn hair. She wears a simple, clean apron over her tunic.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was in her small room above the alchemy shop, cataloging ingredients.
suspects.claimedAlibi: I was in my room, organizing Alistair's ingredient inventory. I heard a faint boom, but thought it was just him experimenting.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: She knows Silas is a disgraced alchemist who envied Alistair. She also knows Alistair had been secretive about his latest project, but she suspects it involved a rare ingredient.

suspects.name: Bartholomew
suspects.personality: Pompous, self-important, concerned with reputation and guild standing.
suspects.physicalDescription: Portly and distinguished, with a neatly trimmed grey beard and sharp, calculating eyes. He wears the formal robes of the Alchemist's Guild.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was attending a late-night Guild council meeting.
suspects.claimedAlibi: I was engaged in a lengthy Guild council meeting. Alistair's work was often… unorthodox. A shame it ended this way.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: He was aware of Silas's disgrace and had warned Alistair about associating with him, but he also saw Alistair's potential breakthrough as a threat to his own influence within the Guild.
suspects.lyingTells: Slightly evasive when asked about the specifics of the Guild meeting and his personal feelings about Alistair's success.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: He knows Silas is a dangerous outcast. He also knows Willow is a talented apprentice but perhaps too trusting.

suspects.name: Elara
suspects.personality: Eccentric, secretive, passionate about her plants.
suspects.physicalDescription: Wild, dark hair often adorned with leaves and flowers. Her hands are stained with soil and plant matter. She wears practical, earthy-toned clothing.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was tending to her greenhouse, which is located across town.
suspects.claimedAlibi: I was in my greenhouse, ensuring my delicate night-blooming flora were properly cared for. Alistair was always pushing the boundaries with what he wanted.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: She knows Alistair was seeking a very rare ingredient, the Sunpetal Bloom, which she supplied. She also knows Silas was desperate for rare ingredients and had tried to steal from her in the past.
